problem: carry a named identity or world constraint across requested tasks
inputs: same compound asset or reference ID in at least two consumers
sequence: prepare or import source, bind source separately to consumers, preserve each binding
interpretation: inferred continuity intent only where case text establishes it
tradeoffs: a central binding creates a wider review surface
failure_modes: equating shared IDs with shared shots, canon or achieved continuity
applicability: multiple disclosed consumers; producer may be unresolved

problem: continue or change a recorded output
method: bind a generated asset to a later request
inputs: explicit producer and material input edge
sequence: generate candidate, bind output, request continuation or change
tradeoffs: changes to an upstream source create downstream review candidates
failure_modes: assuming downstream use proves approval or actual output preservation
applicability: existing different same-film producer; no chronology-only links

problem: retain shared context while deriving local outputs
method: shared input and generated parent in one consumer; axes overlap
inputs: same shared asset plus one or more resolved parents
sequence: bind context, derive candidate, reuse candidate with context
tradeoffs: shared-context and derivative provenance both need retention
failure_modes: forcing a film into one exclusive strategy or treating frequency as authority
applicability: structural motif; semantic identity remains scoped

method: consume outputs of at least two different recorded producers
inputs: distinct same-film producers and exact asset edges
sequence: prepare sources, bind together, generate dependent candidate
tradeoffs: several sources create several change causes
failure_modes: equating producer count with characters, layers or semantic objects

method: retain all nodes and explicit unresolved source states
inputs: all recorded jobs/assets/elements, including unused records
sequence: import, type, connect disclosed edges, retain other nodes
tradeoffs: coverage-aware graphs are less complete than a guessed workflow
failure_modes: calling no edges text-only work, or disconnected disclosure independent production

problem: distinguish source authority from popularity and adoption
method: retain declaration scope, immutable input versions and explicit review events
inputs: authority case 03.6 plus exact graph and change cause
sequence: record declaration, bind version, enumerate candidates after change, human resolves
tradeoffs: explicit decisions add recording work; archive supplies no approval ledger
failure_modes: automatic regeneration or approval revocation based on reachability
applicability: studio hypothesis; validate policy before implementation
